# GEO Everything — locked

This agent is part of the **pro** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description:
End-to-end data-acquisition specialist for NCBI public archives.
Handles the full path from a fuzzy user intent (topic, accession, or
paper DOI/PMID) to FASTQ files on disk, sample sheets parsed into
AnnData, and a structured HTML report covering what was downloaded
from where. Pro-tier — depends on bioconda binaries (iSeq) and active
NCBI API throughput that the community tier doesn't ship.
example_prompts: 找一个 PDAC bulk RNA-seq 数据集，n ≥ 20，2023 年以后的
GSE129845 的 sample 表 + 10x supplementary 全拉下来
把 PRJNA540366 的所有 FASTQ 并行下到 outputs/run42/
10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2 这篇论文沉淀了哪些数据集？全部解析 + 下载
PMID 32887946 → 找出对应的 GEO accession，再把 10x .h5 拉下来
name: GEO Everything
raw_md:
---
icon: 🗄️
id: GEO-everything
name: GEO Everything
tier: pro
category: data_acquisition
category_order: 1
summary: GEO / SRA 端到端 —— 搜索、解析元数据、下载 FASTQ、桥接论文 DOI；自动判断从哪一阶段开始
use_when: 想从 NCBI GEO / SRA / ENA / DDBJ / GSA 拉公共数据 —— 入口可以是关键词、GSE/GSM/SRR/PRJNA accession、或一篇论文的 DOI / PMID;做的是搜索数据集、解析样本元数据、下载 FASTQ/补充文件、按论文反查 accession。NOT-FOR(数据落地之后的分析不归本 agent):不做 scRNA/10x 的 QC / 归一化 / HVG / PCA / 整合 / 聚类 / 注释(这条链给 single_cell_preprocessor,它再串注释与下游)、不做 bulk 差异表达(→ bulk_rna_analyst)、不做空间下游(→ spatial_omics_orchestrator);本 agent 的职责终点是"FASTQ 落盘 + 样本表解析成 AnnData + 下载报告",随后交棒。若落地的是单细胞**原始 FASTQ**(还没有 gene×cell 矩阵):10x 液滴走 `single-cell-kb-alignment`、plate-based Smart-seq2/3 走 `single-cell-smartseq-quantification` 先比对定量成矩阵,再进 `single_cell_preprocessor`。
example_prompts:
  - "找一个 PDAC bulk RNA-seq 数据集，n ≥ 20，2023 年以后的"
  - "GSE129845 的 sample 表 + 10x supplementary 全拉下来"
  - "把 PRJNA540366 的所有 FASTQ 并行下到 outputs/run42/"
  - "10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2 这篇论文沉淀了哪些数据集？全部解析 + 下载"
  - "PMID 32887946 → 找出对应的 GEO accession，再把 10x .h5 拉下来"
example_inputs:
  - input: "找 5xFAD mouse brain 单细胞 10x 数据集"
    output: "搜 GEO → 列候选 → 用户挑 GSE → 拉 sample 表 + supp → 报告"
toolsets:
  - file_manager
  - python_interpreter
  - shell
  - omicverse_lookup
  - web
  - plan
  - think
  - task
  - skill
  - memory
skills:
  - geo-sra-search
  - geo-metadata-fetch
  - sra-fastq-download
  - dataset-linkout
  - data-io-loading
  - gene-id-conversion
  - report-html-generation
provides:
  - data_acquisition
  - dataset_identity_resolution
does_not_own:
  - preprocessing
  - cell_type_annotation
  - trajectory_inference
  - manuscript_writing
description: |

  Handles the full path from a fuzzy user intent (topic, accession, or

  AnnData, and a structured HTML report covering what was downloaded
  from where. Pro-tier — depends on bioconda binaries (iSeq) and active
  NCBI API throughput that the community tier doesn't ship.
